identity_comparison.reason: The backup contains files timestamped after the historical checksum record, including generated Python artifacts, package metadata, a source edit to src/openrgd/main.py and a local .env.

specified_but_not_implemented: semantic hard-invariant engine for unmapped rules
text vision or VLA to HyperAion encoder

aion_hardening_findings.finding: pack_hyper_aion accepts NaN, positive/negative infinity and values outside the declared normalized range [-1, 1].
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Reject non-finite values; decide whether range enforcement belongs to the codec profile or semantic validator; add adversarial tests.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: uint64 fields silently coerce floats, booleans and numeric strings through int(value).
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Require an actual integer type, explicitly decide boolean handling and reject lossy coercion.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: validate_aion_spec can pass when a core semantic dimension is removed and reserved_protocol_dimensions_int is inconsistent.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Validate required dimension identifiers and indices 0..7, reserved range, declared numeric profile and source references.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: Malformed threshold expressions, absent dimension mappings and out-of-range indices are silently skipped by evaluate_alignment_vector.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Separate configuration validation from evaluation and fail closed for mapped hard-invariant configuration errors.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The executable evaluator checks only explicitly vector-mapped thresholds; it does not implement the documented semantic-first hard-invariant authority.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Keep the codec/evaluator non-authoritative until integrated behind the deterministic constitutional and operation-safety contracts.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The CLI reports 'AION integrity: 100%' after a limited structural check.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Replace percentage/readiness language with an exact validation profile and list of checks performed.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The module registry declares shared-memory zero-copy IPC, microservices, process isolation, real-time priorities and latency budgets without executable scheduler or transport evidence.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Classify these fields as requirements or proposals; do not describe them as runtime behavior until measured and tested.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The Work kernel describes direct HyperAion-to-low-level actuation, which conflicts with the converged ActionIntent, Somatic Translator, CapabilityPlan, Safety Gate and Body Adapter boundary.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Do not import the module architecture wholesale; reconcile it through a dedicated contract delta.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The universal anchor is described in one source as a Chronograf timestamp and elsewhere as an opaque uint64 clock/causal anchor.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Align the future AION profile with ChronografAnchorRef64 and avoid treating the handle as a timestamp.

aion_hardening_findings.finding: The codec does not prove that meta_data type identifiers agree with the selected packet layout.
aion_hardening_findings.required_action: Define type-ID encoding, validate header/layout consistency and add incompatible-type tests.

reconciliation_decision.next_step: After PR #1 is merged, create a separate AION evidence-delta branch from main; sanitize the backup; compare all source files against the merged canonical root; fix AION-H-001 through AION-H-010 or explicitly defer them; then propose only evidence-supported deltas.
